theorem lg_target {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] : (HomotopyCategory.plus C).IsVerdierRightLocalizing (HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic C) := by
  have h_closed := HomotopyCategory.instIsClosedUnderIsomorphismsIntUpSubcategoryAcyclic C
  have h_localization := DerivedCategory.instIsLocalizationHomotopyCategoryIntUpQhTrWSubcategoryAcyclic C
  refine CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.instIsVerdierRightLocalizingOppositeOpOfIsVerdierLeftLocalizing _ _ _
  · exact h_closed
  · exact h_localization
  · exact inferInstance
